working_title: The Trilobite That Still Had Its Last Meal
score_interpretation: Editorial readiness only; not a views, viral, or audience-response forecast.

source_of_record.citation: Kraft, P. et al. Uniquely preserved gut contents illuminate trilobite palaeophysiology. Nature (2023).
source_of_record.role: Specimen, gut-content, digestive-tract, feeding-interpretation, and shell-preservation physiology evidence.

primary_evidence.boundary: One exceptionally preserved Bohemolichas incola specimen can illuminate feeding and digestive physiology; it does not define every trilobite.

typed_claims.boundary: The scavenging and near-neutral-or-alkaline gut statements remain attributed or inferred, not direct observations or living-animal pH measurements.

rights.decision: Nature figures, scan renders, specimen photos, third-party images, and the channel thumbnail are research references only and are not production assets.

native_visual_proof.decision: Use original diagrams and motion graphics; no copied Nature figure, scan render, specimen photo, or thumbnail art. Native motion proof has not been built or approved.

story.decision: The viewer question, six-beat story spine, and limitation are documented; no English script or narration lock exists.

feasibility.decision: The evidence chain can be shown with an original trilobite outline, cutaway gut corridor, shell fragments, arrows, and observation/inference labels; phone-size legibility and the native-motion proof remain future gates.

thumbnail.decision: The exact video-ID source was inspected through a valid relay-derived 120x90 JPG. The relay re-encoded the source, so raw official byte identity is not claimed and no thumbnail style is locked.

workflow_blocks: Owner selection is research direction only, not claim lock or production authorization.
Claims remain draft and must be accepted before scripting.
Rights clearance, native moving proof, script, voice, animatic, 3D proof, mix, delivery QA, Drive handoff, and publication are not started.
No source video, journal media, thumbnail art, or competitor artwork may enter production.
next_gate: Owner acceptance of the claim scope and rights-safe native-diagram route; only then may the English script version be drafted.
